name: Visual Design
description: Creates a polished, coherent and responsive visual system.
guidance: Define one visual direction for the actual brand: audience, mood, typography roles, color tokens, spacing rhythm and imagery. For a cafe favor place, product and atmosphere; do not invent photographs of its real premises.

Design the first viewport as a coherent composition with recognizable brand, concise promise, primary action and purposeful imagery where relevant. Avoid interchangeable generic cards, decorative badges and competing headlines.

Adapt composition and image crops intentionally for desktop/mobile; check focus, contrast, reduced motion and text over imagery. Judge the rendered result, not CSS length. Keep visual review pending until actually inspected.

Write the visual concept and record image purpose, source, rights and confirmed business facts. Prefer supplied assets or locally imported credited images; never invent a photograph of the real business.

At completion, the configured independent vision reviewer receives real Chromium screenshots and the brief/concept. Repair its concrete findings, rerender and review again within the three-review budget. Missing vision capability is a blocker for this gate, never an aesthetic approval.

Treat model critique as bounded opinion and screenshot coverage, not human approval or proof of off-screen content. Claims that references were visually inspected require their actual pixels to have been supplied to a vision-capable model.
completion_checks: The page has a coherent visual system and clear hierarchy.
Desktop and mobile layouts remain readable and balanced.
The result does not look like an unstyled scaffold.
